result.notes:
Verdict. The editing carried the report's central corrections faithfully: the withdrawal of the twofold gene-body claim, the bound as a screen, the sensitivity of the zero, the calibration of the control, the counts 7,771 of 19,489 and 3,189 distinct loci, and the code comments named by the report (the Bourgon citation is gone, the step 08 header says step 10). Every number of I-41 and I-03 that comes from this report matches the report. The problems are of three kinds: (1) the residual excess in coding sequence is presented as surviving, in the plan even as attributable to ploidy or heat, although shuffled-label lists show the same excess; (2) the reading of the "organelle" result leans on one report (C4b, "the approximation is conservative") and omits this report's evidence that less conservative tests over-call on lists that resemble real DML; (3) lost qualifiers (mode, strata, number of runs, "from memory", one agent only) and leftovers of withdrawn wording outside issues.md.

Counting rule. 25 items = 12 errors_found + 13 missing_caveats. Carried correctly (15): E4, E7, E8, E12, C1, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C9, C10, C11, C12, C13. Three of these (C1, C4, C9) were carried faithfully but I still report a discrepancy, because the fault is in the report: the 0.30% and ninefold figures are a noisy estimate from 300 permutations, the power caveat contradicts the report's own table, and "cannot hide them" is an untested argument. Carried with loss or error (8): E1, E2, E3, E5, E9, E10, E11, C8. Not yet due (2): E6, C2.

Report details I left out on purpose as low value, not counted as omissions: the top CpG-count bin holds 29 genes; real ploidy DML pass in 10.8% of permutations against 1.1% for other eligible CpGs; the share of loci per feature weighted by null probability (94.6% in gene bodies); the intergenic permutation value 0.30; 12% of permutations with a term in some ontology; real term counts of the first analysis reached by 5% to 30% of random draws; the bound of 0.91% to 99.09% under coverage weighting.

What I recomputed. From 04_output tables: all 20 odds ratios of the first location table, the probability pairs 94.5% and 87.2%, 93.7% and 87.1%, the corrected-mode values, the nine smallest Wallenius q-values, term counts 4,823, 642, 913 and the 88% share, the Fisher counts of both universes, the go_min_genes sensitivity in both modes, the vesicle-coat q-values, 0.105 for the 90 terms, the random-CpG control medians and ranges. From the agent's saved tables: 2.68 (1.44 to 4.53), 58%, CDS 1.58, TE 0.44; 6.4%, 4.0%, 4.0% of 250; 9% to 16%; 13%, 17%, 6% and 88% and 4% for "organelle"; 1.13 and 1.01 with their intervals; 0.44 for the propensity bias variable; the 5% to 95% and 9.09% variants; the power table. All agree with issues.md except where a discrepancy is listed.

Independent replicate of the label permutations (the result that had rested on one agent). My own code on united_cpg_legacy.csv.gz reproduces 1,038 ploidy DML, 2,352 CpGs above 20 points for heat, 981 and 371 DML in genes and CDS, and the pipeline odds ratios. 3,000 permutations: median 739 CpGs passing, 12.9% at or above 1,038; gene-body odds ratio 2.65 (1.47 to 4.52), real value reached in 57%; ratio of the null pass rate inside to outside gene bodies 2.58. The conclusions of the report stand; only the 0.30% and the 95th percentile of 1,226 move. One technical point for whoever writes the diagnostics: methylKit's meth.diff is reproduced to 6e-14 with numCs + numTs as the denominator; with the coverage column the counts are 1,040 and 2,348, which may explain the 1,040 in session_handoff.md.

Support for a statement I checked and do not contest: "nothing remains of the gene-body excess". Shuffled-label lists give a matched gene-body odds ratio with a median of 1.06 to 1.10, and the real 1.13 falls to 1.02 without the I-09 locus.

Cross-report remark for the C5 check: C5's caveat that matching on within-group variation cannot tell chance calls at variable CpGs from regulated CpGs that are also variable is not in I-41. The matched comparison on shuffled labels (omitted item 2) answers it for ploidy.

Limits of my own numbers. The matched comparison under shuffled labels is one new computation by this check (seeds 1618 and 2718, 1,000 and 400 permutations), with the SD classes of C4a (0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 points) and not the deciles of C5; it is not in the repository. Two numbers are wrong (the null median for ploidy labels in I-44, 14 not 15; the upper end of the denominator range in I-16, off by 1, an error of the report itself), and the Verification paragraph of I-16 drops the limits of the report (one agent, methylKit 1.28.0 under R 4.3.3, legacy mode only).
